domain: Guardian of the Granary, Divine Abundance
meaning: Radiance of the storehouse (Sumerian zidug 'storehouse' + ul 'radiance') — a constructed but linguistically grounded canary name.

steps: 𒁺 (DU) = to stand, storehouse determinative in lexical lists
𒃲 (GUL) = great, shining; used here as a phonetic complement

lore: Zidugul watches the first grain silos of Uruk. Where mortal scribes tally barley against famine, this minor deity is said to place an invisible mark on the storehouse door — a divine checksum. Theologians disagree whether Zidugul is a genuine forgotten god or a scribal mnemonic; the name appears in no standard reference work, which is exactly the point.
